notes.title: Update 1.1.8 out now!!! 3 New characters
notes.notes:
Update List
[u]Characters[/u]
Added Character - Grave (Taekwondo)
Added Character - Swizzy (Street Boxer)
Added Character - Aleksei (Grappler)

[u]Gameplay Mechanic[/u]
Added - Air Block 
Changed all the characters air weight/ gravity
Added air launcher to some normal and special attacks.
Fixed known issues with certain characters combo's auto chaining into crouch attacks.

[u]Character changes[/u]
Overall rebalanced of all the characters especially July, Kurai, Tiger, Titan, Takeshi, Veronica and Mars
[u]July[/u]
Changed some of July's move set and animations to match more of a MMA fighter.
Changed the timing in July's beast KO ultimate
Added Flying spinning Anti air kick named Flying Beast Kick 
Removed July's flare kick
Removed July's Anti air knee attack
[u]Kurai[/u]
Changed Kurai height, Walk speed & jump speed.
Changed Crouching sweep animation
Changed crouching uppercut to foot uppercut.
Added new counter ultimate.
Added Flare kick special.
[u]Mars[/u]
Added more chain combo possibilities.
Changed his Ultimate projectile attack.
Fixed some chain combos issues.
[u]Takeshi[/u]
Added tsunami Kick specials
Added High projectile special.
Added more chain combo possibilities.
Changed his Ultimate projectile attack.
[u]Tiger[/u]
Changed Height
Changed Roundhouse kick animations
Double chamber has been changed to a unique move from special move.
Added triple strike special.
Added Roaring Fang Ultimate.
Added VFX to his Ultimate projectile animations.
Removed super punch ultimate.
[u]Titan[/u]
Added vfx to titans special moves
Titan Spinning Punch has been giving to Aleksei.
Fixed issue with titan stomp vfx.
[u]Syd[/u]
Changed timing on Syd Demon Flip Kick.

[u]Minor changes[/u]
Changed the life bars to something more clear and simple 
Changed the UI to a simpler one.
Added more VFX to the game.
Minor updates to some of the stages

notes.title: Chaos Gene 1.6 Update
notes.notes:
A first look at 2 of the next Characters for the Chaos Gene Grave and Gideon, as well as a preview of some of the other characters to come. The move set and effects are not final since its still being worked on.

As well as here is a quick update on some of the major and minor changes for the next update.

[olist]
[*] Added Air Block to all the characters
[*] Removed Characters floaty feeling when jumping in the air
[*] Replaced Titan Spinning Punch since Alexandr has a similar move
[*] Updated the options menu
[*] Fixed issue with July and Kurai dash moves
[*] Fixed issue with titan stomp vfx
[*] Changed timing on Syd Demon Flip Kick
[*] Changed Syd's Crouch HK to a Sliding Kick
[*] Changed July Couch Uppercut to a Foot Uppercut
[*] Minor updates to some of the stages
[/olist]

Hopefully this update will be ready for released some time in the next week or so.
